head: fe9159abdb61f4ae15c01c465f9edc45f4ceeb30
body:
Fixes verified account entitlement inconsistencies and premature marketplace purchase signals while preserving the shared feature handlers and ownership checks.

Three account defects were reproduced before repair:

- Active paid subscribers retaining an old trial date were locked out. Active conversion now supersedes historical trial expiry; actual subscription expiry, MFA and suspended/banned status remain enforced.
- An admin without a public paid plan received 403 from AI content optimization. The route now uses the shared entitlement rule.
- Content analysis admitted inactive/canceled/past-due tier names but rejected active Pro. It now checks current shared entitlements.

New real HTTP tests exercise registration privilege-forgery rejection, admin/paid project creation and persistence, account-scoped listings, foreign read/update/delete denial (including admin on ordinary feature routes), admin-only access, paid conversion/expiry, MFA, concurrent edit conflicts and logout/login persistence. The existing expired-trial fixture now represents an unconverted trial rather than encoding the paid-conversion defect. Provider admission probes use invalid input and stop before external actions; they do not claim live AI generation.

Verification on the source at fe9159abdb61f4ae15c01c465f9edc45f4ceeb30:

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Real isolated PostgreSQL/source-app HTTP suites | 106 pass; zero failures/skips |
| Focused account/isolation/entitlement unit cases | 40 pass; zero failures/skips |
| Existing content service and page/route contracts | 25 pass; zero failures/skips |
| Access-control and subscription-authority contracts | 35 pass; actual PostgreSQL, controlled provider SDK |
| Complete server/client TypeScript checks | PASS |
| Lint on changed files | PASS |
| Production build and final source-to-artifact validation | PASS |

Source hashes, raw artifact hashes, original failures and precise limits are retained in reports/admin-account-verification/2026-11-07/verification.json. No production data or real provider transaction was used.

Earlier changes retained in this PR reject fabricated marketplace paid signals, avoid recording checkout creation as payment, give full TypeScript checks a 4 GiB heap, and make isolated PDIM security checks use their owned channel and fail rather than silently skip. The broader November 6 verification checkpoint remains in reports/production-completion/2026-11-06; its historical counts are not combined with the new scopes.

The active goal is complete private admin use. These checks do not establish every workflow across all 12 domains, live provider outcomes, process-restart recovery, backup restoration, rollback, deployment settings or public capacity. Both private-admin and public production readiness remain UNVERIFIED. Replit's inspection request returned busy/not-submitted and its publication status was unavailable. Source governance defaults allow registration; deployed private-launch settings still need verification. Hosted GitHub CI was previously account-billing blocked; no new hosted CI pass is claimed.

No merge or deployment was performed. AGROS task orchestration and the separate admin acceptance decision remain in PR #210; storage PR #205 remains separate.

+# Admin and regular-account verification — 2026-11-07
+
+Result: shared project workflows and the tested account boundaries pass after three entitlement fixes. This is not full private-admin or public production acceptance.
+
+## Confirmed and fixed
+
+1. Active paid users retaining an expired trial date were blocked even after conversion. Active paid status now supersedes the historical trial date; actual paid expiry, MFA and suspended/banned status remain enforced. The original middleware failed six of the 17 regression cases.
+2. Admin accounts without a public subscription were denied AI content optimization. The route now uses the shared entitlement policy. A real HTTP regression reproduced403 before the fix and now reaches400 input validation; this deliberately avoids provider calls and does not prove generation readiness.
+3. Content analysis admitted inactive, canceled and past-due tier names while denying active Pro accounts. Its router now uses current shared entitlements. Four of six real HTTP cases failed before the fix; all six now pass.
+
+## Executed checks
+
+| Scope | Result |
+| --- | --- |
+| Real isolated PostgreSQL/source-app HTTP suites | 106 passed, zero failures or skips |
+| Focused account, isolation and entitlement unit cases | 40 passed, zero failures or skips |
+| Existing content service and page/route contracts | 25 passed, zero failures or skips |
+| Access-control and subscription-authority contracts | 35 passed, zero failures or skips; actual PostgreSQL, controlled provider SDK |
+| Complete server and client TypeScript checks | PASS |
+| Lint on every changed source/test/config file | PASS |
+| Production build and final source-to-artifact validation | PASS |
+
+HTTP checks cover real registration/login, server-derived ownership, admin and paid project persistence, separate listings, denial of foreign reads/updates/deletes (including admin on ordinary feature routes), non-admin rejection from the admin dashboard, paid conversion/expiry, forged-role rejection, MFA enforcement, one-winner concurrent project updates and persistence through logout/relogin. New checks are registered in the normal integration suite. The expired-trial fixture now models an unconverted trial instead of encoding the former paid-conversion bug.
+
+The full source application ran against disposable PostgreSQL with external TCP/TLS/UDP denied. No production account, customer data, real provider charge, email or publishing action was used. Raw evidence remains private; verification.json records hashes, exact scopes and historical failures. Suite counts are separate and are not added to previous reports.
+
+## Remaining limits
+
+- These checks do not accept every feature across all twelve domains.
+- Live AI generation, distribution, marketing delivery and external payment settlement remain unverified by this run.
+- Logout/relogin persistence was tested; process restart, backup restoration, rollback and public-scale capacity were not.
+- Private-launch governance is configurable and server-enforced, but default source settings allow registration and ordinary-account access. Deployed settings were unavailable and must be verified before private release.
+- Replit returned busy for the inspection question (not submitted) and no current publication status. Local results do not establish the deployed revision or readiness.
+- The fixes remain in draft PR211; no merge or deployment was performed.
+
+This confirms that making an admin workflow work improves the shared application, while separate entitlement and account-boundary checks remain necessary.

+# Max Booster verification checkpoint — November 6, 2026
+
+**Launch decision: NO-GO.** Replit has accepted continuation work for the user-confirmed **MaxBooster 7.5** app. That background task is separate from these completed local checks; acceptance of the task is not deployment or readiness evidence.
+
+Tested product source: `8e6b4fbcc24932d0962ab925d8df0ac2e09e9520` on `codex/production-completion`, based on `89e8b6c8e65d1fad757743a1027b0ea32708efac`. The local checkout retained its base HEAD plus the five exact source overlays listed by SHA-256 in [verification.json](verification.json). All five files were read back from GitHub and matched local contents. Generated build outputs and endpoint reports were not committed as product changes.
+
+The product changes reject fabricated paid marketplace interactions, stop recording checkout initiation as a sale, prevent an analytics outage from stranding a created checkout session, and give both complete TypeScript compiler invocations sufficient heap. The isolated security fixture now uses its actual private PDIM port and token; its real-authority cases fail rather than silently skip when that fixture is unavailable.
+
+| Check | Actual result |
+| --- | --- |
+| Production build | PASS, including frontend, embedded MaxCore API and runtime entries |
+| Final source/artifact hash validation | PASS after verification |
+| Full server/client typecheck | PASS through ordinary `npm run check`; no session-only heap override |
+| Lint | PASS; subsequently changed verification files also passed targeted lint |
+| Production dependency audit | PASS; zero reported vulnerabilities |
+| CI-style runtime/security/storage and unit command | PASS; 2,875 unit cases, zero failures or skips; other command scopes retained separately |
+| New marketplace HTTP regression | 6/6 PASS; the same tests against original handlers produce three expected failures and three passes |
+| Full isolated HTTP suite | 501 pass, seven provider/generation skips, zero failures, 508 reported cases |
+| Real PDIM security recheck | 24/24 PASS, zero skips, including both previously skipped live-store window-boundary cases |
+| Browser route observations | 80 scoped declarations: 42 authenticated, 11 administrator, 27 public; no route-observation failures |
+| Instrumented platform assertions | 2,918 PASS across 302 selected test modules; zero failures or skips |
+| Whole-platform JS/TS coverage | FAIL unchanged 100% thresholds across 2,658 source files: lines 13.21%, statements 13.11%, functions 8.84%, branches 8.94% |
+| Coverage evidence/source identity | Parent-bound fresh evidence, no coverage parse exclusions, source inputs unchanged |
+| Completion-plan generation | FAIL: stale/missing page-analysis mappings; existing requirements remain open |
+| AGROS runner tests | 33/33 PASS on separate commit `d9d5f7969a71d0a0ed31e3572af99b46fd70437f` / PR #210 |
+| GitHub Actions | BLOCKED: GitHub explicitly reports an account billing lock before job execution |
+| Actual Replit publication | UNVERIFIED; inspection returned no current publication status, and this local execution did not publish |
+
+These counts overlap and must not be summed. Route rendering is not whole-page business acceptance. The browser fixture intentionally leaves model/public-awareness readiness degraded and labels untested categories; it does not prove full-stack generation, provider delivery, accessibility compliance, capacity, backup recovery, or release readiness.
+
+Initial failures remain recorded: the original default-heap typecheck crashed, the first unit run lacked the Redis test executable, and the first HTTP run lacked PyTorch for the real MaxCore subprocess. After provisioning and the documented source fixes, the repeated checks passed their stated scopes. Two security cases had additionally skipped because of incorrect fixture authority wiring; the repaired cases now execute against the real private store. The seven remaining skips require actual enabled provider or generation capabilities and were not replaced with simulated success.
+
+Next work remains the existing completion ledger: close actual coverage and feature gaps, reconcile stale page analysis without discarding requirements, complete configured provider/generation sandbox journeys, and establish real deployment, migration, recovery, accessibility and capacity evidence. AGROS also needs its trusted repair executor and missing evidence producers. No readiness threshold was lowered; neither PR was merged or promoted to production by this execution.
+
+Machine-readable commands, source hashes, measured counters, retained-log checksums, initial failures and remaining blockers are in [verification.json](verification.json). The task used disposable databases, private storage, synthetic users and fixture-only credentials. Raw logs remain private in the execution workspace instead of being copied wholesale into GitHub.
